author: HackerOS
name: HackerOS app solution
description: A repository for a HackerOS app: the app, a host that runs it in the OS, its tests, the HackerOS submodule (sources in Debug, packages in Release), CI and the Hack Store publishing workflow.

appId.description: Application id (reverse-DNS, lowercase), unique in the catalog.

publisherId.description: Publisher id written in the manifest.

repository.description: GitHub repository of the app (owner/name), written in store/store.json for the Hack Store.
